policy: External validation is release-specific. Automated QA may verify that HOLD boundaries are represented truthfully but must never manufacture human, device, learner, accreditation, signing, or production-site evidence.

technicalAutomation.claim: Strongly automated and technically governed; no external-validation claim is implied.

governance.required: Add or confirm an independent trusted reviewer, apply the canonical main governance policy to GitHub's live main ruleset, verify the exact live ruleset, then change this status to enforced.

accessibility.required: Release-specific human NVDA and VoiceOver validation across the governed matrix.

pwaPhysicalDevices.required: Current-release physical iOS/iPadOS and Android install/update/offline validation. Prior release waivers do not authorize this release.

bookSme.required: Independent human SME approval of all 46 governed Book chapters across the six required review dimensions.

curriculumSme.required: Traceable human SME semantic approval of all 120 canonical lessons.

learnerOutcomes.required: Longitudinal real-learner outcome evidence before efficacy or genuine psychometric-validity claims.

productionUse.requiredForExpansion: Formal controlled-site validation, safety/governance review and explicit authorization before any machine-control or validated-recipe authority.

visualGovernance.required: Apply and verify the canonical independent-review main ruleset with at least one genuine latest-head human approval; automated checks and self-review do not substitute for that approval.

nzqaProvider.required: Genuine provider ownership, stakeholder need, provider-approved design, authorised assessment/internal moderation, consent-to-assess/CMR confirmation, applicable national moderation, workplace evidence and provider-controlled review/change evidence for the exact governed release.
